reviews.title: So disappointed
reviews.text: I finally upgraded to the premium version, expecting so much more.  I am not able to add items with a title/label and its nutritional values.  The database is pretty much nonexistent.  Every barcode I scan is not found in the database and unlike other apps, you cannot add it, which tells me the database will continue to fall short of other apps like fitness pal, Omada, heck, just about every other app I’ve used.  If I enter an item’s nutritional info, o cannot label the item.  I reached out to tech support and never heard back.  This was a feature I expected to be there when I upgraded.  While i can track my glucose levels, the substandard food database makes the app practically useless for me since I’m still having to use other apps to log my foods and those do not log my glucose levels.  This app was a complete waste of money for me.  I’m still searching for an app that has a great food database, tracks nutritional information I need, as well as my glucose levels.  Still searching and out money for this app.  Sad.

reviews.title: Food tracker is a joke
reviews.text: I bought this app so that I could have one place for my glucose, exercise and food logs. I was using MyFitnessPal to track my food and a paper log to track my glucose and wanted one place to see the data and get a better picture of what’s going on. The food tracker is really frustrating. The barcode doesn’t work and their data base of food is so small that it doesn’t have Daves Killer Bread Good Seed or any Good Culture products - things I eat every day! And the log displays individual food items without the option of just displaying meals, so my simple avocado egg toast breakfast ends up taking up 6 line items in the log. Really disappointed as food is the first line of control in managing my gestational diabetes.

My email address was removed from my settings info which is why the app and website will not recognize me as a user of the app. The website support is non existent. Please fix the bug. I’ve written to them at their email address as well as used the form online. No response. Is there no one from tech support monitoring these emails and questions? Update: I have cancelled my subscription that I’ve had for a number of years. It makes me sad that this wonderful app is now not working and is useless.

reviews.title: App is lacking some features that are required
reviews.text:
Last time I emailed their support I never got a response. My stupidity in deciding to try this app again. Following are some of the frustrations with this app - note that I subscribed to the premium tier  

1. It doesn’t read anything from Apple health other than steps. Any blood glucose readings that are in apple health will not be viewable in the app. 

2. It doesn’t write anything to Apple health. Any blood glucose readings you enter here are not viewable anywhere but this app. 

3. Scanning barcodes is hit or miss. First one I tried was not found. 

4. It will read steps from Apple health, but doesn’t include exercise (or anything else). 

5. Careful if trying the 7 day free trial. I got immediately billed as I had tried this app years ago. Didn’t inform me that the free trial was no longer available - very sneaky.

reviews.title: Not sure if this is for Type 2 folks
reviews.text:
Just downloaded this today, and trying to add Ozempic to the meds. The only dosage periods are 1-6 times a day, versus once weekly. So, I had to turn off its monitoring.

I was also told by my physician to measure my blood sugar about 2 hours after a meal, but preferably at least once in the morning and once before I go to bed. But the app pinged me to take a measurement almost immediately after eating. 

There also doesn’t seem to customize the blood sugar range - my doctor wants me to control it in a more narrow range than the average.

Lastly, the photo of food seems to be a great tool but maybe I am not using it right to measure a mixed ingredient meal like stew to capture quantities of each ingredient.

I will let you all know if my experience improves.

reviews.title: Used to be great

Mine has been deleted and I’m not able to re-enter it. I’ve sent an email to support with no reply after a week. I can only assume this is because I don’t subscribe, i.e. I’m a freeloader.

reviews.title: I tried to add my coffee first time today
reviews.text:
I’m not diabetic, but I have family members who are. One recommended this to me. I tried to input my morning coffee and I can’t use normal cream so I tried to put my silk half-and-half. The user experience is not very good on the base level, making it look like you can customize. It should say “This is a Premium Feature” or something. 

I cannot put in custom info, but it tells me to put in the calories? Here it has a crown (indicating premium), but it allows you into that section? Guess it’s black coffee or individual parts? Just shouldn’t allow adding custom items in user experience just put a crown next on that tab and block the whole section.

reviews.title: Great app but has bugs.
reviews.text:
This app is extremely handy when it comes to helping me log food, carbs and insulin. It helps me keep track of when to give insulin and how much, counting carbs etc. Been using it for years BUT: 
Needs an update! 
It can no longer find any barcode that I scan, and when I actually am able to log carbs, the carb count is incorrect. 
Ex: if I’m eating 45 carbs of rice, the app keeps trying to turn that 45 count into 1600. 
Please fix these bugs so that we can accurately log our carb count. :)

reviews.title: Poor Carb Data

reviews.title: I tell everyone about this app!
reviews.text: After getting out of the hospital less than 2 months ago: I’ve been able to lose 31.2lbs (as of today) and taken my a1c down almost 2%. It’s very easy to use; keeps track of my glucose levels, body weight, calorie intake, counts macros. I literally tell everyone, I couldn’t have done this well for this long had it not been for this app. No fast food or take out. Knowing I’d have to log that in the app, makes me want to go eat something healthy from my own kitchen! Thank you!
